name: Gian Tool MCP real Codex Provider acceptance

methods.expect: returns the GianDev Workspace and ready Agents
lists canonical Tasks without direct database access
updates name, description, pinned, and lifecycle state
filters Sessions by the canary Task
creates a cheap-model Codex Session from workspace_id and agent_id
returns the created Session and resolved config
updates Session metadata and next-Turn config
assigns an initially unassigned child Session to the canary Task
starts one child Turn and queues a second delivery while busy
cancels the queued delivery without cancelling the active Turn
observes terminal child delivery state without polling SQLite
returns child messages and Turn config snapshot
lists pending interactions, including an empty result when none exist
resolves a real child Provider interaction when one can be provoked
stops an active child Turn and is an idempotent no-op when idle
completes and reopens the child Subtask
archives and restores the child Session explicitly

crossChecks: Every listed method appears as a real MCP tool call in the controller Session transcript.
If Codex defers a method-specific tool, gian_call reaches the same method without bypassing validation or idempotency.
The controller and child Sessions use the cheapest ready Codex model advertised by catalog.
Repeating one write with the same explicit idempotency_key replays rather than duplicating its Host side effect.
No Electron process is started and ports 8990/5190 remain untouched.
Created canary resources are left archived and clearly named for later inspection.
